Back cover with advertising for other LEGO Creator sets. No building steps.

Three separate groups are expected. The booklet builds three separate models in turn: the digger (pages 2-9), a quad bike (pages 10-16) and a buggy (pages 17-22). Each model is taken apart and rebuilt from the same physical pieces. They are separate by design and should not be connected to each other.

Because each model reuses the same pieces, the part counts exceed the 57-piece list when the three models are added together. The extra nodes are real pieces in the later models, not mistakes. Each single model stays within the list apart from the uncertain identifications noted earlier.

The Technic pin (lego-4274) is added here. It is not clearly visible in the pages, and its placement is a guess at the pivot between the digger arm (b30) and the bucket (b31). It may belong to another model.

Earlier piece identifications are low-confidence because the images are small, especially yellow plates and dark gray round pieces. Only additions are returned, so the earlier parts and edges stay as given.
